episodes.title: Macondo
episodes.summary: Fearing a ghost and a curse, Úrsula and José Arcadio leave their town to establish a new home along a few others, braving a journey through tough terrain.

episodes.title: Es como un temblor de tierra
episodes.summary: Aureliano has visions of a war, while José Arcadio Jr. meets a woman. José Arcadio's alchemy obsession pushes Ursula to find a way to support the family.

episodes.title: Un daguerrotipo de Dios
episodes.summary: An odd girl brings a delirious sickness to Macondo. José Arcadio becomes fascinated by Melquiades' camera. Rebeca and Amaranta vie for Pietro's attention.

episodes.title: El castaño
episodes.summary: A new mayor and his family settle in Macondo. Aureliano experiences love for the first time, while a death drives José Arcadio into madness.

episodes.title: Remedios Moscote
episodes.summary: Arcadio becomes the school's principal, and Pilar has significant news for Aureliano. Remedios fills the Buendía home with joy — until tragedy strikes.

episodes.title: El coronel Aureliano Buendía
episodes.summary: José Arcadio Jr. returns, shocking everyone with his wild nature, specially Rebecca. Amid political unrest, Aureliano becomes a revolutionary leader.

episodes.title: Arcadio y el paraíso liberal
episodes.summary: Arcadio enforces liberal rule in Macondo, while Aureliano attempts to free a colonel from the conservatives. The looming threat of war finally arrives.

episodes.title: Tantas flores cayeron del cielo
episodes.summary: Years later, when Aureliano reveals his war plans for Macondo, a heartbroken Ursula comes to a shocking realization about her family.

episodes.title: El armisticio
episodes.summary: Identical in looks but different in fates, Aureliano Segundo and Jose Arcadio Segundo forge their own paths as Col. Aureliano decides the world's fate.

episodes.title: La reina de Madagascar
episodes.summary: Macondo is mesmerized by a new beauty — but everything that blooms must wilt. Aureliano Segundo meets Petra, who unknowingly wanders between two men.

episodes.title: Fernanda del Carpio
episodes.summary: Aureliano Segundo is enamored with Fernanda del Carpio but falls into old ways. A deal is struck. The colonel is honored as the 17 Aurelianos gather.

episodes.title: Había llegado el inocente tren
episodes.summary: A new railway connects Macondo to the outside world, but as foreigners settle in, a cruel reality sets in. The Buendías witness a miraculous vanishing.

episodes.title: Fue un once de octubre
episodes.summary: Upon her return, sparks fly between Meme and Mauricio Babilonia. As love and heat blossom between them, so does Fernanda's rage. A mutiny brews.

episodes.title: Eran más de tres mil
episodes.summary: Tensions between farmhands and United Fruit Co. break into an all-out massacre that devastates Macondo, its residents and José Arcadio Segundo.

episodes.title: Llovió cuatro años, once meses y dos días
episodes.summary: Macondo's death blow takes shape as Fernanda hides another secret, and Úrsula gives her descendants a dire warning. The twins' fate entwines once again.

episodes.title: Cien años de soledad
episodes.summary: Aureliano Babilonia and Amaranta Úrsula revel in their rotting paradise. After a century and a birth, a cursed lineage is erased and forgotten.
